name: agrifeed-tooling
description: Rules build, emulator scripts and automated Firebase tests for AgriFeed (local only).

scripts.emulators: npm run rules:build && npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-agrifeed
scripts.test:rules: npm run rules:check && node scripts/run-with-emulators.mjs database -- npx vitest run tests/rules
scripts.test:functions: npm run functions:build && node scripts/run-with-emulators.mjs auth,database,functions -- npx vitest run tests/functions
scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions
scripts.emulators:lan: npm run rules:build && npm run functions:build && node scripts/emulators-lan.mjs
